payload.description:
Purpose: 150e07 persists grants and HTTP sinks on development ThinTurn. Remaining 4ddbe1 gap: the model/worker tool loop can still request forbidden effects without going through those sinks.

Acceptance:
- Computerless (and computer continuation if it uses tools) worker enforces the same CapabilityPolicy sinks as PUT grant / POST workspace/read — one path, no dual policy.
- A model-requested forbidden workspace/browse/egress is denied at the sink; the denial is visible on the turn (journal or HTTP) without leaking secrets.
- Granted read-only / in-scope tools still succeed.
- desiredCount stays 0. No cdk deploy --all, no production, no 35d86b / PR #26.
payload.title: Wire gated capability sinks into the live model tool loop
